name: The Book Of Revelation
overview: The Book of Revelation reveals the unveiling of Jesus Christ's divine plan for the end times, as given to John through an angel to show His servants what must soon come to pass. It emphasizes the certainty and imminence of Christ's return, when every eye will see Him, including those who pierced Him, prompting a universal response of mourning. The vision includes symbolic imagery such as the seven stars representing the angels of the seven churches and the seven golden candlesticks symbolizing the churches themselves, highlighting Christ's authority and presence among His people. Additionally, it portrays heavenly control over earthly events, as seen in the four angels holding back the winds, underscoring God's sovereign hand in the unfolding of future judgments.
